pairs.evidence: src-tauri/src/commands/companion/mod.rs:223 companion_init runs recover_orphans, which closes every job left 'running' as status='failed' and appends ' [orphaned by process restart]' to error_text (src-tauri/src/companion/jobs/mod.rs:189) - an unearned failure verdict whose real cause is only recoverable by string-matching the message

techniques.evidence: src-tauri/src/companion/jobs/mod.rs:189 the restart cause is encoded as a suffix inside a failure message instead of a first-class indeterminate status; the job vocabulary has no such status

pairs.subject: agent-runtime-assembly
pairs.evidence: src-tauri/src/cloud/runner.rs:73 the cloud run is polled from an in-process task whose remote handle lives only in memory (src-tauri/src/state.rs:40 cloud_exec_ids HashMap, filled at src-tauri/src/commands/infrastructure/cloud.rs:639) and is never persisted, so an app restart orphans the remote run: it cannot be re-attached, its result is lost, and it cannot be cancelled

techniques.evidence: src-tauri/src/cloud/runner.rs:57 run_cloud_execution takes the cloud_execution_id as an argument from memory; the rule 'persist the remote handle and lease before returning, poll from a background runtime outside the run with the store as truth' is unmet - polling is host-side (not model-visible), but the handle is not durable
